Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, Acme's preferred procurement route is an AWS Marketplace Private Offer so billing flows via your AWS account. To keep the procurement timeline tight I drafted a short mutual action plan (MAP) and listed the required artifacts below. Can you confirm the procurement contact and any internal review windows?

Mutual Action Plan (summary)
- Target close: 2026-03-17 (customer acceptance of Private Offer)
- AWS Private Offer creation: Redwood to create and submit private offer (we provide SKU, pricing, and PoF) — target 2026-03-06
- PO issuance: Acme procurement submits PO to AWS referencing Private Offer ID — target 2026-03-10
- DocuSign/order confirmation: Accept private offer via AWS/DocuSign — target 2026-03-12
- Prod onboarding & billing verification: go-live 2026-04-01

Required artifacts from Redwood (what we will provide)
- AWS Private Offer draft & pricing sheet (attached once you confirm)
- Standard SOW & order summary for internal review
- W-9 and vendor details for your AP team

Options for billing path (confirm which you prefer)
1) AWS Marketplace Private Offer (recommended): Acme is billed by AWS, Redwood receives payment via AWS Marketplace. Simplifies AP for Acme; standard for many enterprise customers.
2) Direct vendor billing: Redwood invoices Acme directly after purchase (requires Redwood to be on your vendor list and may introduce additional procurement steps).

Please confirm: (a) procurement contact name/email, (b) whether Acme will accept AWS Marketplace billing, and (c) any internal approval dates we should hit. Once you confirm we will spin up the Private Offer and send the DocuSign link.

Attachments (stubs): aws-private-offer-invoice-template.pdf (sample), pricing-summary.xlsx (internal)

Thanks —

Proposed concession: 15% market-entry credit for first 3 months, applied at the AWS invoice reconciliation step (we will reconcile with AWS payouts).

Why: moves close earlier, protects list price in future renewals, low one-time cost relative to ARR.

Can we sign off on a 15% promo (or counter with 10% if you want tighter margins)? I need a verbal OK before I commit to the 3/12 acceptance deadline. Also flagging that AP will request W-9 and vendor contact; Dev has attached the Private Offer draft.

Quick timeline recap:
- 3/06: RDW pushes Private Offer to AWS
- 3/10: Acme issues PO to AWS
- 3/12: Accept Private Offer / DocuSign complete
